BiblicalUsage: A sekiyah is a conspicuous object, a pleasant picture, and Isaiah sets it among the proud things God will bring low: upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
TheologicalSignificance: What I see here is that even beautiful things are judged when they are the pride of men — the ships and the pictures fall together.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
